title: Empire! The British Imperial Experience 1558-1997
description:
Credit only granted for: HIST219P or HIST233.
Formerly: HIST219P. Britain's empire from the mid-sixteenth century to the late twentieth century, focusing on the encounter between Britain and indigenous peoples. Topics include the origins of British imperialism in Ireland and North America, the slave trade, the East India Company and India, women in empire, transportation and the making of Australia, sex in empire, missionaries, racial theories, and decolonization.
